$schema_notes: Compiled staging dataset for Chile climate-finance opportunities. The seed preserves every row of the reviewed v1 inventory without treating inherited claims as freshly verified. Programme/call/geography separation and current usability are added only when primary evidence supports them.
title: Chile municipal climate-finance opportunities (compiled)
grain: one row per observed programme, call/application window, geographic variant, route, or enabling platform; record_scope identifies which

scope.in_scope: All 99 records in oef/cl-city-action-fundability v1 as a lossless seed, followed by national and regional primary-source research for climate-relevant opportunities accessible to or facilitated by Chilean municipalities.
scope.not_yet_in_scope: A claim of exhaustive coverage of every municipal or private opportunity in Chile; current-call verification for every seed row; action matching; production display eligibility.
scope.complete_when: Every seed record has an explicit reconciliation disposition; all 16 GORE and named national source families have a dated search result; programme families and calls are separated; current display candidates are backed by current primary evidence; derived fields are rules rather than undocumented judgment; every record carries a known applicant_class and a themes_norm list that is not cross_sector.
scope.no_loss_rule: seed count = carried/split/merged/superseded/rejected records, with no unexplained disappearance

field_provenance_legend.sourced: Read from a primary source, or preserved verbatim from the reviewed seed inventory with verification_status explicitly stating that it has not yet been rechecked in this compile.
field_provenance_legend.derived: Assigned by review judgment and not source-stated; must not drive display until reviewed.
field_provenance_legend.derived-by-rule: Computed by a documented exact rule or lookup in references/.

fields.name: record_id
fields.notes: seed- plus the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(source_dataset|program_name|source_url).

fields.name: record_scope
fields.notes: Seed rows remain seed_unspecified until primary-source review establishes their true grain.

fields.name: program_family_id
fields.notes: Blank until an exact family rule is recorded.

fields.name: geography_id
fields.notes: Region/comuna identifier only when source-stated or assigned through an auditable lookup.

fields.name: status_claim
fields.notes: Original seed status; never silently overwritten.

fields.name: normalized_status
fields.notes: Blank until dated primary evidence is checked.

fields.name: gpc_sectors
fields.notes: JSON text preserved from the seed.

fields.name: route_scope
fields.notes: How specific the route is. Normalised from the seed's specificity claim: sector-specific becomes targeted, broad becomes general, blank becomes unknown. Downstream, a targeted route can produce a specific action match and a general route can only produce a general one.

fields.name: funds_what
fields.notes: What the money buys. Exact lookup on instrument_type in references/funding-mode-map.csv, then two documented adjustments: a record whose record_scope is enabling_platform is preparation, and a per-programme entry in references/route-profile-overrides.csv wins over both. An applicant_class of unknown does not block this field, because the instrument is source-stated.

fields.name: applicant_class
fields.notes: Primary beneficiary class. Exact lookup on the verbatim eligible_actor string in references/applicant-class-map.csv. Never inferred: an eligible_actor of unspecified maps to unknown.

fields.name: municipality_eligible
fields.notes: Whether a municipality can itself receive the money, held separately from applicant_class because the two diverge: a municipality that owns forest land can apply to a landowner fund, while in a producer programme delivered through a municipal convenio the city implements without receiving (implementer). Same lookup file as applicant_class.

fields.name: themes_norm
fields.notes: JSON list. Normalises the seed's gpc_sectors vocabulary onto the action-sector vocabulary: buildings becomes stationary_energy, water is retained as its own theme with no action-sector counterpart, and cross_sector is preserved rather than replaced by a guessed list. A per-programme entry in references/route-profile-overrides.csv can replace the list where the source states the works class.

fields.name: current_display_eligible
fields.notes: False for all seed-only records. Can become true only under a documented display rule after current primary-source verification.

promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (lock scope, finish primary verification, convert derived fields to rules, peer review) -> catalog/pipeline; this compile must not be consumed directly as production truth.
